title: Intel Advances Next Generation 18A-P Chip to Risk Production. This Is a Big Deal for INTC Stock.
title_zh: 英特尔推进下一代 18A-P 芯片的风险生产。这对 INTC 股票来说是一件大事。
summary: Intel just cleared a major milestone in its race to reclaim manufacturing leadership. Here is what it means for the company and for the future of AI computing.
summary_zh: 英特尔刚刚在夺回制造领先地位的竞赛中取得了一个重要的里程碑。这对于公司和人工智能计算的未来意味着什么。

title: When You Play Defense With Consumer Staples, Which ETF Should You Own? Funds From State Street and First Trust Offer a Stark Choice.
title_zh: 当您防御必需消费品时，您应该持有哪只 ETF？道富银行和第一信托基金提供了一个严峻的选择。
summary: Compare portfolio strategies and sector exposures as two leading consumer staples ETFs take different paths to long-term returns.
summary_zh: 比较投资组合策略和行业风险敞口，因为两个领先的消费必需品 ETF 采用不同的长期回报路径。

title: Microsoft Corporation (MSFT): One of the Best Falling Stocks Despite Getting Out of Oracle Data Center Deal
title_zh: 微软公司（MSFT）：尽管退出了甲骨文数据中心交易，但仍是跌幅最大的股票之一
summary: Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) is one of the best falling stocks to invest in, according to analysts. On June 17, Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) stock edged lower amid reports it had abandoned plans to lease an Oracle Data center.
summary_zh: 分析师表示，微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）是最值得投资的下跌股票之一。 6 月 17 日，微软公司（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）股价小幅走低，有报道称该公司已放弃租赁甲骨文数据中心的计划。

title: Morgan Stanley (MS) Buys Into UK Rentals With £1.045b Metra Living Deal
title_zh: 摩根士丹利 (MS) 以 1.045 英镑收购英国 Rentals Metra Living 交易
summary: Morgan Stanley Investment Management and Ridgeback Group agreed to acquire Metra Living, the PRS business of London & Quadrant Housing Trust, for £1.045b. The deal expands NYSE:MS into UK residential rental assets at a time of housing supply constraints in key urban areas.
summary_zh: 摩根士丹利投资管理公司和 Ridgeback Group 同意以 1.045b 英镑收购 London & Quadrant Housing Trust 的 PRS 业务 Metra Living。在主要城市地区住房供应紧张之际，该交易将 NYSE:MS 扩展到英国住宅租赁资产。
